EE.Settings.HideDmTokens.Name: Hide DM-dropped tokens from players
EE.Settings.HideDmTokens.Hint: When you (the GM) drop a token onto a scene, make it invisible to players while still letting them target and interact with it. Toggle any single token from its HUD with the eye icon.
EE.Settings.DisableDragAnimation.Name: Disable token drag animation
EE.Settings.DisableDragAnimation.Hint: Dragging and dropping a token moves it instantly instead of gliding it to the destination at Foundry's fixed animation speed. Applies to everyone at the table, and only to drag-and-drop — keyboard movement still animates.
EE.Settings.HotbarPageSwap.Name: Swap hotbar page on token selection
EE.Settings.HotbarPageSwap.Hint: Selecting a token switches the hotbar to the page assigned to that token's character. Nothing else in this window has any effect until this is on.
EE.Settings.RefreshRaisedPortraits.Name: Refresh raised portraits on artwork change
EE.Settings.RefreshRaisedPortraits.Hint: When a character's portrait image changes while Ginzzzu's Portraits is showing it, update the raised portrait to match instead of leaving the old artwork on screen. Portraits with a custom image or an active emotion are left alone.
EE.Settings.GeneralFeaturesMenu.Name: General Features
EE.Settings.GeneralFeaturesMenu.Label: Configure
EE.Settings.GeneralFeaturesMenu.Hint: Token visibility, drag movement, and keeping raised portraits in step with character artwork.
EE.Settings.HotbarPagesMenu.Name: Per-Token Hotbars
EE.Settings.HotbarPagesMenu.Label: Configure Assignments
EE.Settings.HotbarPagesMenu.Hint: Choose which hotbar page each character switches to, and which page to fall back to for everything else.
EE.HotbarPages.Title: Per-Token Hotbars
EE.HotbarPages.Notes: Assign a character to a hotbar page and the bar switches to that page whenever one of its tokens is selected.
EE.HotbarPages.DefaultHint: Shown when an unassigned token is selected, or when nothing is selected at all.
EE.HotbarPages.ApplyToPlayersHint: Off by default: players keep their own macros on their own pages, so only your hotbar follows the selection.
EE.HotbarPages.NoActors: This world has no actors to assign.
EE.Settings.DaggerheartAutomationMenu.Hi: Integrations with Daggerheart-specific modules, including syncing character portraits to The Void's Hybrid Form.
EE.Settings.VoidHybridFormPortrait.Name: Sync portrait to Hybrid Form
EE.Settings.VoidHybridFormPortrait.Hint: When The Void puts an Order of the Lycan character into Hybrid Form, change the character sheet portrait to match the transformed token art, and change it back when the form is dropped.
EE.Settings.VoidHybridFormPrototype.Name: Also transform the prototype token
EE.Settings.VoidHybridFormPrototype.Hint: Additionally rewrite the character's prototype token, so a token dragged onto a scene mid-transformation arrives in Hybrid Form. Off by default: unlike the portrait, this changes saved character data.
EE.GeneralFeatures.Title: General Features
EE.Automation.Title: Daggerheart Automation
EE.Automation.VoidMissing: The Void (Unofficial) is not installed or not enabled. These options will do nothing until it is.
